messages.subject: Cross Level Sampler
parts:
Hi all,
I was wondering if you have any examples of the cross level sampler being used in any tutorials on github? I just like to see concrete examples before I use tools.
Thanks!
-Alison

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: Cross Level Sampler
parts:
Indeed, you might take a look at Section 7.11 ("Detailed MCMC example: litters") of the NIMBLE User Manual.  This walks through using the crossLevel sampler applied to the "litters" example, one of the recurring example models which is used throughout the manual.

Hope this helps,
Daniel
